title: Explicit close, media cleanup, and distinct next wake
goal: Prove that explicit close restores Python wake ownership and the same saved wake can establish a distinct second Realtime session before final cleanup.
preconditions: BACKEND=realtime is configured with a usable OpenAI credential and network connection.
The loopback Realtime host is launched and Arm hands-free audio has been clicked once.
A private local wake fixture has already been recorded.

evidence.offline: The same fail-closed oracle evaluates sanitized two-session lifecycle snapshots without devices, network, credentials, audio, or sleeps.
evidence.live_host: The runner automatically replays one private wake twice around two explicit stops under one Arm lease; no fresh human speech is required.
